title: Everyday family moments
description: A boy walks with his father, a girl reads, a mother cooks with her daughter.
sceneSummary: A short narrated scene of everyday family life: a boy walks with his father, a girl reads a book, and a mother cooks food with her daughter. It practises describing what people are doing right now with the present continuous (is + -ing).
